learning_document.title: Working with Pandas DataFrames
learning_document.overview: Pandas is the foundational data manipulation library in Python, and the DataFrame is its central object. This session takes you from creating and inspecting DataFrames to grouping and summarizing a real sales dataset, closing with how to frame the findings for stakeholders.
learning_document.summary: You can now create DataFrames from dictionaries and CSV files, inspect them with head, info, describe, and shape, compute per-group statistics with groupby, and structure findings so decision-makers can act on them. The next session applies these tools to messy, real-world data cleaning.
